Grade: Grade 3
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.2: Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick, part of Strand 6 in Grade 3 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: when you recovery showing care for the sick, visit the sick?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.
